sources.title: CIA World Factbook · archived country profile

recognition: Cartographic classification in Natural Earth: Dependency. This classification is not a statement of international recognition.
provenance: Country facts are from the archived CIA World Factbook mirror. Officeholders and economic/military data are reference observations, not a live update.
summary: Pitcairn, Henderson, Ducie and Oeno Islands. Parliamentary democracy.
rulers: King CHARLES III (since 8 September 2022); represented by UK High Commissioner to New Zealand and Governor (nonresident) of the Pitcairn Islands Iona THOMAS (since 9 August 2022); Mayor and Chairman of the Island Council Shawn CHRISTIAN (since 5 November 2025)
economy: small South Pacific British island territorial economy; exports primarily postage stamps, handicraft goods, honey, and tinctures; extremely limited infrastructure; dependent upon UK and EU aid; recent border reopening post-COVID-19
asOf: Archived Factbook edition; individual figures retain their stated years.
